disruptions.title: SEAJETS - Trip schedule modifications for ferry EUROCHAMPION JET 2
disruptions.content:
From 10 October to 18 October, the following SEAJETS trips operated by ferry EUROCHAMPION JET 2 will depart at new times:

  • Departure from Naxos at 15:35 - departure from Mykonos at 16:25 - departure from Syros at 17:05 - arrival in Piraeus at 19:15.

disruptions.title: SEAJETS - Trip cancellations for ferry AQUA BLUE due to adverse weather
disruptions.content: From 12 October to 15 October, the scheduled trips operated by Seajets with ferry AQUA BLUE have been cancelled due to expected adverse weather conditions.
